diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit depends_on from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :module.karpenter is redundant because the release values already reference outputs from that module.
The explicit depends_on from :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class to :module.eks is redundant because its triggers/template data reference outputs from the EKS module.
The explicit depends_on from :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class to :module.karpenter is redundant because its triggers and manifest reference outputs from the Karpenter module.
The explicit depends_on from :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig to :module.eks is redundant because the provisioner command references module.eks.cluster_name.

The Calico installation custom resource should be created only after the Tigera operator has finished becoming available; the explicit ordering only waits for the operator manifest apply command, not necessarily operator readiness.
The EKS add-ons should follow creation of the cluster itself; the current explicit ordering waits for the self-managed node group but does not express dependence on :module.eks.
